content.text:
Submitted.

**Repairs made in this pass:**
1. **Deterministic check "Customer convenience termination present":** cured in operative language — the grant now reads "Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement **for convenience** at any time, for any reasons…", so the element text is express rather than inferred from "without Cause"/"for any reasons". Two words added; minimality re-validated `ok:true`.
2. **Residual item — §13.5:** re-read (p0634–p0636). It confers termination rights on **Ono only** (Safety Reasons, 30 days; Efficacy Reasons, 180 days). Combined with §§13.3, 13.4 and 8.2, Array has no at-will exit anywhere in Article 13, so element 4 remains **already_met** on the verbatim §13.3 quote and no carve-out sentence is added.
3. **Residual item — §8.2 Competing Product tail:** flagged in the rationale as a separate point for negotiation rather than expanded into this redline, per the minimality guidance.

Final position: **deviation**, preferred level, one surgical replace of §13.2 (gate deleted, 30 days' notice fixed, pro rata refund of period-allocated prepayments added); §§13.1, 13.3, 13.4, 13.5 and 6.1 untouched and uncontradicted.
